newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-MICRON Q4 ESTIMATE CUT.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-MICRON Q4 ESTIMATE CUT.

text.p: Painewebber Inc analyst John Lazlo cut his fourth-quarter earnings and revenue estimates for Micron Technology Inc because of falling prices for memory chips, according to a research report released Tuesday.
-- Lazlo said he lowered his fourth-quarter earnings per-share estimate range to $0.20 to $0.41 from $0.62 before.
-- He also lowered his revenue forecast to $985 million for the quarter from $1.1 billion.
- Although Micron's 16-megabit chips are selling well, the spot price for the chips is $5.70 to $5.80, down from $6.00 in late July, cutting into revenue, Lazlo said.

- "We continue to rate the stock neutral owing to the prospects for further aggressive DRAM (memory chip) price degradation which will result in less confidence in the fiscal year 1998 earnings outlook," Lazlo wrote.
- Micron shares were down 2-9/16 at 52-1/2 in early afternoon trade.
